summary: Modernization platform shows strong architectural foundation with schema-driven validation and modular agent design. Critical gap: missing VB6 legacy artifacts prevents actual modernization execution. Security and authentication mechanisms undefined.

hotspots.reason: No VB6 source artifacts (.frm, .frx, .bas, .cls) present in repository despite VB6 modernization objective

provenance.evidence: No VB6 file extensions detected in 122 scanned files

hotspots.reason: Missing Microsoft Access source schema and PostgreSQL target schema definitions

provenance.evidence: Empty SQL sections in database conversion context

hotspots.reason: No authentication mechanisms or security controls identified in API endpoints

provenance.evidence: HTTP endpoints without visible auth decorators

hotspots.reason: Inconsistent error handling patterns across agent modules

provenance.evidence: Varied import patterns and error handling approaches

risks.title: Missing Legacy System Artifacts
risks.description: VB6 modernization cannot proceed without source VB6 files, forms, modules, and database schemas

risks.title: Undefined Data Migration Strategy
risks.description: Access to PostgreSQL migration lacks source schema, data contracts, and migration validation

risks.title: Security Architecture Gap
risks.description: No authentication, authorization, or security controls defined for API endpoints

risks.title: Testing Strategy Incomplete
risks.description: Tester agent exists but no test frameworks, coverage requirements, or validation criteria defined
